scope: Descriptive availability, no effect estimates or confidence intervals. Panel A uses all observed modeled target records as denominators, including identical models; focal means a background includes the duplicate taxon. Panel B ranks taxa by support using alignment E-value policy; zero-support taxa remain. Absent target taxa are outside these denominators. Strict set requires native ortholog assignment and unreported parent duplication in both guide alternatives; this does not establish speciation. Other qualification sets and distance ranges remain in the full source table.
